apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  labels:
    app: tetris
    managed-by: argocd
  name: tetris
  namespace: staging
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tetris
  template:
    metadata:
      annotations:
        prometheus.io/port: "8080"
        prometheus.io/scrape: "true"
      labels:
        app: tetris
    spec:
      containers:
      - image: localhost:5001/devsecops/tetris:latest
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
        name: tetris
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /home/node/.npm
          name: npm-cache
        - mountPath: /tmp
          name: node-tmp
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 1000
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
      volumes:
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: npm-cache
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: node-tmp
---

FROM jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk17

ARG KUSTOMIZE_VERSION=v5.4.3

USER root
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      awscli \
      ca-certificates \
      curl \
      docker-buildx \
      docker-cli \
      git \
      jq \
      python3 \
      unzip && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# GitOps promotion uses `kustomize edit set image`. Resolve the archive name
# from the image architecture so the Jenkins image also builds on Apple Silicon.
RUN set -eux; \
    architecture="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "${architecture}" in \
      amd64) kustomize_arch="amd64" ;; \
      arm64) kustomize_arch="arm64" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${architecture}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    curl -fsSL \
      "https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/releases/download/kustomize%2F${KUSTOMIZE_VERSION}/kustomize_${KUSTOMIZE_VERSION}_linux_${kustomize_arch}.tar.gz" \
      | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin kustomize; \
    kustomize version

USER jenkins
COPY ./ci/plugins.txt /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt
RUN jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt

# =============================================================================
# ci/Dockerfile.agent
# OWNED BY: Linh (Team 1)
#
# Jenkins CI agent image with all tools pre-installed.
# My (Team 2) uses this image to run scan scripts.
# Build: docker build -t devsecops-agent:latest -f ci/Dockerfile.agent .
# Push:  docker tag devsecops-agent:latest localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#        docker push localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#
# Tools installed:
#   Build:    Node.js 20, JDK 17, npm
#   Security: Trivy, TruffleHog, Gitleaks, OWASP Dep-Check, Semgrep, Checkov, Cosign
#   k8s:      kubectl, helm, argocd CLI
#   Scan:     SonarQube Scanner
# =============================================================================


FROM ubuntu:22.04 

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Can adjust version of trivy or another tool that you want for " CONTAINER - FILE SYSTEM SCAN " PHASE. 
ENV TRIVY_VERSION=0.50.1  

# 
ENV SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION=5.0.1.3006
ENV DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION=9.0.9
ENV NODE_VERSION=20

# ── Base tools ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl wget git unzip zip ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release \
    openjdk-17-jdk-headless python3 python3-pip jq docker.io \
    && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ── Node.js 20 ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_VERSION}.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs && apt-get clean

WORKDIR /tools

# ── Trivy (container + filesystem scan) ──────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-64bit.tar.gz \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin trivy

# ── TruffleHog v3 (verified secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN curl -sSfL \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/main/scripts/install.sh \
    | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin

# ── Gitleaks (pattern-based secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN GITLEAKS_VER=$(curl -sf \
    https://api.github.com/repos/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/latest \
    | jq -r .tag_name) && \
    curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/download/${GITLEAKS_VER}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VER#v}_linux_x64.tar.gz" \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin gitleaks

# ── OWASP Dependency-Check (SCA) ─────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/releases/download/v${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}/dependency-check-${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}-release.zip" \
    -o /tmp/dc.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/dc.zip -d /opt \
    && ln -s /opt/dependency-check/bin/dependency-check.sh /usr/local/bin/dependency-check.sh \
    && rm /tmp/dc.zip

# ── SonarQube Scanner (SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonar-scanner-cli/sonar-scanner-cli-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux.zip" \
    -o /tmp/sonar.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/sonar.zip -d /opt \
    && mv /opt/sonar-scanner-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux /opt/sonar-scanner \
    && ln -s /opt/sonar-scanner/bin/sonar-scanner /usr/local/bin/sonar-scanner \
    && rm /tmp/sonar.zip

# ── Semgrep (additional SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir semgrep

# ── Checkov (IaC scan) ────────────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir checkov

# ── Cosign (image signing) ────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/latest/download/cosign-linux-amd64" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/cosign && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cosign

# ── kubectl ───────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN KUBECTL_VER=$(curl -sf https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt) && \
    curl -sfL "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VER}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/kubectl && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubectl

# ── Helm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash

# ── Smoke test ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN echo "=== Tool versions ===" \
    && node --version \
    && npm --version \
    && trivy --version \
    && trufflehog --version \
    && gitleaks version \
    && sonar-scanner --version \
    && checkov --version \
    && cosign version \
    && kubectl version --client \
    && helm version \
    && echo "=== All tools OK ==="

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash"]

# =============================================================================
# ci/Dockerfile.agent
# OWNED BY: Linh (Team 1)
#
# Jenkins CI agent image with all tools pre-installed.
# My (Team 2) uses this image to run scan scripts.
# Build: docker build -t devsecops-agent:latest -f ci/Dockerfile.agent .
# Push:  docker tag devsecops-agent:latest localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#        docker push localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#
# Tools installed:
#   Build:    Node.js 20, JDK 17, npm
#   Security: Trivy, TruffleHog, Gitleaks, OWASP Dep-Check, Semgrep, Checkov, Cosign
#   k8s:      kubectl, helm, argocd CLI
#   Scan:     SonarQube Scanner
# =============================================================================


FROM ubuntu:22.04 

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Can adjust version of trivy or another tool that you want for " CONTAINER - FILE SYSTEM SCAN " PHASE. 
ENV TRIVY_VERSION=0.50.1  

# 
ENV SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION=5.0.1.3006
ENV DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION=9.0.9
ENV NODE_VERSION=20

# ── Base tools ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl wget git unzip zip ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release \
    openjdk-17-jdk-headless python3 python3-pip jq docker.io \
    && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ── Node.js 20 ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_VERSION}.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs && apt-get clean

WORKDIR /tools

# ── Trivy (container + filesystem scan) ──────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-64bit.tar.gz \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin trivy

# ── TruffleHog v3 (verified secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN curl -sSfL \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/main/scripts/install.sh \
    | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin

# ── Gitleaks (pattern-based secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN GITLEAKS_VER=$(curl -sf \
    https://api.github.com/repos/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/latest \
    | jq -r .tag_name) && \
    curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/download/${GITLEAKS_VER}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VER#v}_linux_x64.tar.gz" \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin gitleaks

# ── OWASP Dependency-Check (SCA) ─────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/releases/download/v${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}/dependency-check-${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}-release.zip" \
    -o /tmp/dc.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/dc.zip -d /opt \
    && ln -s /opt/dependency-check/bin/dependency-check.sh /usr/local/bin/dependency-check.sh \
    && rm /tmp/dc.zip

# ── SonarQube Scanner (SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonar-scanner-cli/sonar-scanner-cli-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux.zip" \
    -o /tmp/sonar.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/sonar.zip -d /opt \
    && mv /opt/sonar-scanner-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux /opt/sonar-scanner \
    && ln -s /opt/sonar-scanner/bin/sonar-scanner /usr/local/bin/sonar-scanner \
    && rm /tmp/sonar.zip

# ── Semgrep (additional SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir semgrep

# ── Checkov (IaC scan) ────────────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir checkov

# ── Cosign (image signing) ────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/latest/download/cosign-linux-amd64" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/cosign && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cosign

# ── kubectl ───────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN KUBECTL_VER=$(curl -sf https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt) && \
    curl -sfL "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VER}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/kubectl && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubectl

# ── Helm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash

# ── Smoke test ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN echo "=== Tool versions ===" \
    && node --version \
    && npm --version \
    && trivy --version \
    && trufflehog --version \
    && gitleaks version \
    && sonar-scanner --version \
    && checkov --version \
    && cosign version \
    && kubectl version --client \
    && helm version \
    && echo "=== All tools OK ==="

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash"]

FROM jenkins/jenkins:lts-jdk17

ARG KUSTOMIZE_VERSION=v5.4.3

USER root
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
      awscli \
      ca-certificates \
      curl \
      docker-buildx \
      docker-cli \
      git \
      jq \
      python3 \
      unzip && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# GitOps promotion uses `kustomize edit set image`. Resolve the archive name
# from the image architecture so the Jenkins image also builds on Apple Silicon.
RUN set -eux; \
    architecture="$(dpkg --print-architecture)"; \
    case "${architecture}" in \
      amd64) kustomize_arch="amd64" ;; \
      arm64) kustomize_arch="arm64" ;; \
      *) echo "Unsupported architecture: ${architecture}" >&2; exit 1 ;; \
    esac; \
    curl -fsSL \
      "https://github.com/kubernetes-sigs/kustomize/releases/download/kustomize%2F${KUSTOMIZE_VERSION}/kustomize_${KUSTOMIZE_VERSION}_linux_${kustomize_arch}.tar.gz" \
      | tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin kustomize; \
    kustomize version

USER jenkins
COPY ./ci/plugins.txt /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt
RUN jenkins-plugin-cli --plugin-file /usr/share/jenkins/ref/plugins.txt

# =============================================================================
# ci/Dockerfile.agent
# OWNED BY: Linh (Team 1)
#
# Jenkins CI agent image with all tools pre-installed.
# My (Team 2) uses this image to run scan scripts.
# Build: docker build -t devsecops-agent:latest -f ci/Dockerfile.agent .
# Push:  docker tag devsecops-agent:latest localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#        docker push localhost:5001/devsecops-agent:latest
#
# Tools installed:
#   Build:    Node.js 20, JDK 17, npm
#   Security: Trivy, TruffleHog, Gitleaks, OWASP Dep-Check, Semgrep, Checkov, Cosign
#   k8s:      kubectl, helm, argocd CLI
#   Scan:     SonarQube Scanner
# =============================================================================


FROM ubuntu:22.04 

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Can adjust version of trivy or another tool that you want for " CONTAINER - FILE SYSTEM SCAN " PHASE. 
ENV TRIVY_VERSION=0.50.1  

# 
ENV SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION=5.0.1.3006
ENV DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION=9.0.9
ENV NODE_VERSION=20

# ── Base tools ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    curl wget git unzip zip ca-certificates gnupg lsb-release \
    openjdk-17-jdk-headless python3 python3-pip jq docker.io \
    && apt-get clean && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# ── Node.js 20 ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_${NODE_VERSION}.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y nodejs && apt-get clean

WORKDIR /tools

# ── Trivy (container + filesystem scan) ──────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-64bit.tar.gz \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin trivy

# ── TruffleHog v3 (verified secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN curl -sSfL \
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/trufflesecurity/trufflehog/main/scripts/install.sh \
    | sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin

# ── Gitleaks (pattern-based secrets) ─────────────────────
RUN GITLEAKS_VER=$(curl -sf \
    https://api.github.com/repos/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/latest \
    | jq -r .tag_name) && \
    curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/zricethezav/gitleaks/releases/download/${GITLEAKS_VER}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VER#v}_linux_x64.tar.gz" \
    | tar xz -C /usr/local/bin gitleaks

# ── OWASP Dependency-Check (SCA) ─────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/jeremylong/DependencyCheck/releases/download/v${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}/dependency-check-${DEPENDENCY_CHECK_VERSION}-release.zip" \
    -o /tmp/dc.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/dc.zip -d /opt \
    && ln -s /opt/dependency-check/bin/dependency-check.sh /usr/local/bin/dependency-check.sh \
    && rm /tmp/dc.zip

# ── SonarQube Scanner (SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://binaries.sonarsource.com/Distribution/sonar-scanner-cli/sonar-scanner-cli-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux.zip" \
    -o /tmp/sonar.zip \
    && unzip -q /tmp/sonar.zip -d /opt \
    && mv /opt/sonar-scanner-${SONAR_SCANNER_VERSION}-linux /opt/sonar-scanner \
    && ln -s /opt/sonar-scanner/bin/sonar-scanner /usr/local/bin/sonar-scanner \
    && rm /tmp/sonar.zip

# ── Semgrep (additional SAST) ─────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir semgrep

# ── Checkov (IaC scan) ────────────────────────────────────
RUN pip3 install --no-cache-dir checkov

# ── Cosign (image signing) ────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL \
    "https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/latest/download/cosign-linux-amd64" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/cosign && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/cosign

# ── kubectl ───────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN KUBECTL_VER=$(curl -sf https://dl.k8s.io/release/stable.txt) && \
    curl -sfL "https://dl.k8s.io/release/${KUBECTL_VER}/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl" \
    -o /usr/local/bin/kubectl && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/kubectl

# ── Helm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/helm/helm/main/scripts/get-helm-3 | bash

# ── Smoke test ────────────────────────────────────────────
RUN echo "=== Tool versions ===" \
    && node --version \
    && npm --version \
    && trivy --version \
    && trufflehog --version \
    && gitleaks version \
    && sonar-scanner --version \
    && checkov --version \
    && cosign version \
    && kubectl version --client \
    && helm version \
    && echo "=== All tools OK ==="

ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash"]

metadata:
  labels:
    app: tetris
    managed-by: argocd
  name: tetris
spec:
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: tetris
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: tetris
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
      - image: tetris-devsecops:latest
        livenessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
        name: tetris
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
          name: http
          protocol: TCP
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /
            port: http
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 10
          timeoutSeconds: 2
        resources:
          limits:
            cpu: 200m
            memory: 128Mi
          requests:
            cpu: 50m
            memory: 64Mi
        securityContext:
          allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
          capabilities:
            drop:
            - ALL
          readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
        volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/cache/nginx
          name: nginx-cache
        - mountPath: /var/run
          name: nginx-run
        - mountPath: /tmp
          name: nginx-tmp
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 101
        runAsGroup: 101
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 101
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      volumes:
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: nginx-cache
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: nginx-run
      - emptyDir: {}
        name: nginx-tmp
